lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee mil sa(n)gatee mere govi(n)daa jan naanak naam sidh kaajai jeeu ||4||4||30||68||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one joins the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, O my Lord of the Universe; O servant Nanak, through the Naam, one's affairs are resolved. ||4||4||30||68||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai har naamai har birahu lagaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord has implanted a longing for the Lord's Name within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa har prabh mit milai sukh paaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: I have met the Lord God, my Best Friend, and I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh dekh jeevaa meree maaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meraa naam sakhaa har bhaaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is my Friend and Brother. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavahu sa(n)t jeeu mere har prabh kere jeeu ||
lines.translation: O Dear Saints, sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap guramukh naam jeeu bhaag vadere jeeu ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O very fortunate ones.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam jeeu praan har mere jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: phir bahuR na bhavajal phere jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I shall never again have to cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu har prabh vekhaa merai man tan chaau jeeu ||
lines.translation: How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body yearn for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har melahu sa(n)t jeeu man lagaa bhaau jeeu ||
lines.translation: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints; my mind is in love with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee paaeeai har preetam raau jeeu ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have found the Sovereign Lord, my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee jap naau jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: O very fortunate ones, chant the Name of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man tan vadaRee govi(n)d prabh aasaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Within my mind and body, there is such a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har melahu sa(n)t jeeu govid prabh paasaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Unite me with the Lord, Dear Saints. God, the Lord of the Universe, is so close to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mat naam sadaa paragaasaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, the Naam is always revealed;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak pooriaRee man aasaa jeeu ||4||5||31||69||
lines.translation: the desires of servant Nanak's mind have been fulfilled. ||4||5||31||69||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa birahee naam milai taa jeevaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: If I receive my Love, the Naam, then I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man a(n)dar a(n)mrit guramat har leevaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the temple of the mind, is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, we drink it in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man har ra(n)g rataRaa har ras sadaa peevaa jeeu ||
lines.translation: My mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. I continually drink in the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har paaiaRaa man jeevaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: I have found the Lord within my mind, and so I live. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man tan prem lagaa har baan jeeu ||
lines.translation: The arrow of the Lord's Love has pierced by mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa preetam mitr har purakh sujaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Primal Being, is All-knowing; He is my Beloved and my Best Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mele sa(n)t har sughaR sujaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Saintly Guru has united me with the All-knowing and All-seeing Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hau naam vitahu kurabaan jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har har sajan har meet dasaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: I seek my Lord, Har, Har, my Intimate, my Best Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dasahu sa(n)tahu jee har khoj pavaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: Show me the way to the Lord, Dear Saints; I am searching all over for Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur tuthaRaa dase har paaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Kind and Compassionate True Guru has shown me the Way, and I have found the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har naame naam samaaee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, I am absorbed in the Naam. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai vedan prem har birahu lagaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: I am consumed with the pain of separation from the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saradhaa poor a(n)mrit mukh paaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Guru has fulfilled my desire, and I have received the Ambrosial Nectar in my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har hohu daiaal har naam dhiaaee jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord has become merciful, and now I meditate on the Name of the Lord.

lines.transliteration: jan naanak har ras paaee jeeu ||4||6||20||18||32||70||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. ||4||6||20||18||32||70||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 raag gauRee guaareree chaupade ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl, Raag Gauree Gwaarayree, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kin bidh kusal hot mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: How can happiness be found, O my Siblings of Destiny?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu paaeeai har raam sahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kusal na grihi meree sabh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: There is no happiness in owning one's own home, in all of Maya,

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooche ma(n)dar su(n)dar chhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: or in lofty mansions casting beautiful shadows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothe laalach janam gavaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: In fraud and greed, this human life is being wasted. ||1||
